rules.name: push_main
rules.reason: Pushing to a protected branch is denied by policy. Open a PR instead.

rules.name: force_push
rules.reason: Force push rewrites remote history and is denied. Use --force-with-lease if a force is truly required.

rules.name: force_with_lease
rules.reason: Lease-guarded force push rewrites remote history. Confirm before proceeding.

rules.name: mirror_push
rules.reason: git push --mirror overwrites all remote refs and is denied.

rules.name: delete_branch_remote
rules.reason: Deleting a remote branch is irreversible. Confirm.

rules.name: push
rules.reason: Pushing publishes commits. Confirm before proceeding.

rules.name: delete_branch_local
rules.reason: Force-deleting a local branch can lose unmerged commits.

rules.name: reset_hard
rules.reason: git reset --hard discards working-tree and index changes.

rules.name: clean_force
rules.reason: git clean -f removes untracked files (and -fdx removes ignored too).
